worldcombat.skill.entrainment.summary: Dances an odd rhythm that compels the target to mimic it, making the target's Ability the same as the user's; enemies caught by the beat change with it.
worldcombat.skill.entrainment.use.0: Hand your own detrimental Ability to a foe
worldcombat.skill.entrainment.use.1: Overwrite a dangerous foe Ability with an ordinary one
worldcombat.skill.entrainment.use.2: Change the Abilities of the whole ring of enemies around you
worldcombat.skill.entrainment.descriptio: Dances a beat within %1$s blocks after a %2$s s wind-up, travelling at about %3$s blocks/tick.
When the beat lands, each caught enemy's Ability becomes the caster's for %1$s s; the splash radius is %2$s blocks.
About %1$s beats line up along the path and about %2$s sway points circle the landing spot; every caught enemy lights a link line.
worldcombat.skill.entrainment.whole.0: Whole-field beat: splash ×1.6, duration ×0.65, cooldown +16 ticks; change the whole ring that closed in on you at once.
worldcombat.skill.entrainment.whole.1: Close beat: splash ×0.7, duration ×1.4, cooldown −10 ticks; hold one opponent to your rhythm for much longer.
worldcombat.skill.entrainment.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.entrainment.growth.0: At level %1$s the committed cooldown shortens to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.entrainment.growth.1: At level %1$s the committed cooldown shortens again to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.entrainment.preference: On = whole-field beat: splash ×1.6, duration ×0.65, cooldown +16 ticks, change the whole ring at once. Off = close beat: splash ×0.7, duration ×1.4, cooldown −10 ticks, hold one opponent much longer. Coverage trades against duration.
Only consider the rhythm against a threat inside this distance; larger dances earlier from farther away, smaller only at close range.
On, a holding companion will leave its post to change a foe's Ability; off, it only casts when already in reach.
world_combat.move.entrainment.text.share: %1$s were caught by the rhythm and changed
